sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for sharing your data regarding delivery and the updated demand forecast. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As to the delivery record and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. While we appreciate the increased volume, our pricing structure remains firm due to our current operational constraints.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can accommodate the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract at €4.91 per unit, offering a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest in our products and for placing your trust in Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always strive to provide you with the best possible service and support for your requirements.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Due to our operational constraints, we must hold firm, making €4.94 for a 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms our final offer. To summarize our current Angebot, we are offering a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days. Please let us know if you are able to proceed under these conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
